title: Building Energy Benchmarking & Retrofit Targeting

blueprintSignals.name: Normalised EUI
blueprintSignals.definition: annual kilowatt-hours per square metre after weather and occupancy adjustment
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Area definitions differ, so use the standard gross internal area

blueprintSignals.name: Peer percentile
blueprintSignals.definition: rank of the building's normalised EUI within its peer group
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Peer groups with few members are unstable

blueprintSignals.name: Envelope age
blueprintSignals.definition: year of construction and of the last major facade or window upgrade
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Records are often missing, so use the building age as a fallback

blueprintSignals.name: System type
blueprintSignals.definition: heating and cooling system class, such as gas boiler, heat pump or chiller

label: For "Building Energy Benchmarking & Retrofit Targeting": Benchmark building energy use against peers and rank buildings for retrofit by savings and payback. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Retrofitted buildings differ from the rest, so their results are not comparable with unretrofitted ones.
